title: Handprint in the Rain
description: A nighttime rainy urban street scene viewed through a large glass panel. A human hand covered in dripping orange paint presses against the glass leaving a bright orange handprint, while in the reflection a person in a dark coat stands on the wet street with one arm raised under neon lights.
prompt: A dramatic nighttime scene of a rainy city street with wet reflective pavement and glowing neon signs. A large glass panel in the foreground shows a human hand covered in thick dripping orange paint pressed against the glass, creating a vivid handprint. In the reflection, a solitary figure in a long dark coat stands on the street with one arm raised. Cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere, heavy rain, high detail, realistic textures.
